information: **Please note that this competition will not have traditional speedsolving events and not recommended for first time competitors.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoYouRememberSanDiego2024#43178-competitor-responsibilities-and-faq) tab. ​ Spectators will not be permitted to attend this competition. ​ This competition is sponsored by [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com) and [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com): ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU2ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b4beb2aaa280e75cf0c6820fc2648045b5411eb5/scswcc5.png)
